title: Code reviews: the last 15 months
description: Running total of code reviews since August 2025: 1,253 by the review bot in four months against 867 by humans in fifteen. Titled as the team's own chart. Drawn from _code-reviews/data.js.
series: Code reviews: humans and the bot
source: code_reviews_weekly.csv (weekly reviews, Feb 5, 2024 to the week of Nov 2, 2026), and the team's own chart "Cumulative code reviews: humans and the review bot" (Nov 2026), whose text the image uses: 371 PRs reviewed by the bot, 374k lines merged after bot review, about 326 hours saved (5 min + 1 h per 500 lines changed per PR, capped at 2 h, re-reviews not counted).
